theme: Surface to Deep Ocean - Premium cinematic AI analytics product. 85% premium tech, 15% DataKat personality.

rules: Surface->Depth transition must be progressive (controlled scroll range with fading overlay)

sections.design: Transparent at top, transitions to translucent navy on scroll. Left: Script Wordmark. Right: Product, How It Works, Security, Sign In, Get Started. Mobile uses Lucide Menu/X.

100vh full-bleed media. Image preserved on right. Text constrained to 35-40% width on left. Localized translucent blue/navy gradient behind left-side text. Eyebrow: 'ANALYST INTELLIGENCE, ON DEMAND.'. Heading: 'Your AI\nData Analyst.'. Support: 'Ask your data a business question in plain English. DataKat finds the relevant data, analyzes it, and explains the answer clearly.'. CTAs: 'See DataKat in Action →', 'How it works'.

Deep marine blue background (#0A1428). Heading: 'Ask the question. Get the answer.' Support: 'No dashboards to build. No SQL to write. Ask DataKat the same way you'd ask an analyst.'. Interface: NOT a chat bubble, but a refined product-style analytical UI showing the specific table data provided in the prompt.
Background descends darker. 'Connect. Ask. Analyze. Understand.' 4 stages presented editorially (NOT identical glowing cards). Spatial, elegant typography.
Heading: 'Ask the questions that usually take another dashboard.'. 6 questions displayed in a slow editorial marquee.
Background #080D18. Heading: 'More than text-to-SQL.'. 8-step technical sequence with restrained animated connecting line. No AI brains or code rain.
Heading: 'Built for controlled analytical access.'. 6 concepts presented calmly. No padlock cliches.
Background #05070D. Sequential reveal: 'Not another dashboard.', 'Not another SQL editor.', 'Not another chatbot.', 'An analyst you can talk to.' Large editorial typography.
Deepest point #05070D. 'Your data already knows the answer.' / 'What do you want to know?'. CTAs: Get Started, Sign in.

components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee with slow speed, no gradients. Editorial typography.
components.buttons: Restrained, premium. Primary: bg-[#00D9FF] text-black hover:bg-white. Secondary: text-white hover:text-[#00D9FF].

image_urls.description: Sunlight filtering through deep blue ocean water, acting as the 'Surface' of the ocean.

testing.instructions: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, navigation items) MUST include a kebab-case role-based data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color progression from hero image to #0A1428 to #080D18 to #05070D on scrolling.
Ensure the hero background has a subtle localized gradient overlay on the left side to make the white text readable, but keep the right side completely clear to see the ocean/activity.
Use standard Lucide React icons. Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals with the exact stagger and timing provided.
The DataKat logo should use the 'Dancing Script' or 'Caveat' font inline if an image is not available, as it must be a script wordmark.
Do NOT invent any metrics, pricing, or testimonials.
DO NOT use standard Shadcn card styles for 'How it Works' or 'Differentiation'—use editorial, cardless layouts.
Implement the 'More than text-to-SQL' section using an SVG connecting line that animates using Framer Motion (pathLength).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs (no glowing brains, no 'AI slop').
Create depth through layered design elements and z-index hierarchy, NOT aggressive gradients.
Do not apply global 'transition: all' styles.
Do not center align app containers by default.
Provide micro-interactions (hover, active) for all clickable elements.
